candidate.derivedAnswer: D: Two lines that do not lie in any common plane
candidate.answerReason: Skew lines are noncoplanar. Equivalently, they neither intersect nor are parallel, which agrees with D.

methods.label: Characterization of skew lines
methods.explanation: Parallel lines are coplanar. Skew lines neither intersect nor are parallel.
methods.levelReason: Uses only the elementary classification of two lines in space.

review.mathematicalCheck: Skew lines neither intersect nor are parallel. If they shared a plane, their nonintersection would make them parallel, a contradiction. Hence they have no common plane, selecting D.
